data.body:
Re-verifying after the follow-up landed.

The single unmet criterion was 'The template fixture asserts it is virgin (no tickets, no <repo>/.rebar/)'. The verifier was correct: the fixture only checked .rebar, and the no-tickets half lived solely in test_template_stays_virgin. Rather than argue the criterion into compliance with an evidence comment, the gap was closed properly in ticket 446c-1d56-9163-499d (change 1070, merged as b91cda9b3), linked discovered_from this ticket.

tests/interfaces/conftest.py on main now carries both:
  :86   assert rebar.list_tickets() == []           (inside the MonkeyPatch context)
  :103  assert not (repo / '.rebar').exists()

Both this ticket's commit (817dd7aaa) and the follow-up's (b91cda9b3) are reachable from HEAD in the worktree this close runs from.
